summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.09/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.09 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 20, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 5¢ higher than a week ago, 27¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.55 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.86) and the highest in Superior ($4.31).
